scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && npm run dev:apps
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:lite: npm run dev:prepare && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait postgres redis minio
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w dogrsc-frontend && npm run lint -w dogrsc-admin
